blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — An unidentified gunman tried, but failed, to kill a village councilman in Datu Piang, Maguindanao del Sur on Friday, Nov. 6, police said. Capt. Steffi Salanguit, spokesperson of Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR), identified the victim as Abdul Manab Guialodin, village councilor of Barangay Liong. Liong sustained several gunshot wounds from the attempt on his life. Salanguit said responding police officers learned the village official was driving his multicab vehicle on the way to the town center at 11 a.m. when ambushed by a lone gunman in Barangay Balanaken.
